learning_outcomes: Understand the fundamentals of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI).
Apply user-centered design principles to systems, components, or processes.
Conduct user research using industry-standard methods and evaluate products for usability.
Develop and iteratively improve design solutions addressing real-world user problems.
Gain hands-on experience with prototyping and usability testing.
Work effectively in small teams to complete a semester-long design project.
Enhance soft skills, including teamwork, communication, and presentation.
Create and share prototypes and deliverables with a focus on user needs.
Provide and receive constructive peer feedback on design solutions.
topics: Applying HCI principles to solve real-world user problems
Designing for future technologies such as AI and XR
